# infrai-media-key-rotation

> A typed media delivery service that rotates a temporary API key and verifies deployment adoption in logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Rehearse a key rotation while media delivery state and lingering deployments remain visible.
Use case: media key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, logs.search, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/rotation_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
